paper_title: Extraterrestrial Axion Search with the Breakthrough Listen Galactic Center Survey
suggested_experiment_name: Breakthrough Listen GBT Galactic Center Survey
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Astrophysical search for axion-photon conversion in GC neutron star magnetospheres using Breakthrough Listen GBT C-band data. Sets 95% CL upper limit g_agamma ~ 1e-11 GeV^-1 over m_a in 15-35 ueV. No numerical table provided; the exclusion curve is in Fig. 1 and only the approximate level (~1e-11 GeV^-1) is quoted in the text, so the two emitted points represent an approximate flat bound spanning the stated mass range. Local DM density 0.346 GeV/cm^3 (NFW normalization) assumed. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 34)) | Vision: Figure 1 (title page). The line is noisy (forest of narrow spikes); the smooth median envelope was traced. Limit hovers near 1e-11 GeV^-1 across 15-27 ueV and rises toward ~1e-10 at high mass. Y-axis reaches ~2e-11 in the DM-plausible band. Frequency top axis 4-8 GHz corresponds to mass range.
